data.name: Info_Audit_What
data.value: It checks whether the whole project meets its requirements, not just one run. The system checks the latest saved version and a judge gives its verdict. The report says whether you can rely on it.

data.name: Info_Audit_Actions
data.value: Choose the judge and declare who wrote the code. Press "Prepare" to see the estimate: it spends nothing. Press "Audit" and approve to launch it. Read in the report whether it is reliable and why.
